where: top, section header 'HOSPITAL COURSE' and 'Edit' button on Background Summary
what: The Hospital screen has one brown 'Edit' button, on the summary only, and none on the section header. The NH screen of the same kind has two black 'Edit' buttons, one on the section header and one on the summary. The buttons differ in number, position and color across the two contexts.

This screen says 'Background Summary' and 'Course Timeline' where NH says 'Admission Summary' and 'Visit Timeline'. The NH timeline entries are prefixed 'Visit N –' and the Hospital ones show only a date. This may be intentional, but the labels differ for the same component.

where: top right, two 'Edit' buttons stacked about 100px apart (section header and Admission Summary)
what: There are two identical 'Edit' buttons next to each other with no label saying what each one edits. A physician can't tell whether the top one edits the whole course or something else.

where: bottom, collapsed card 'Oct 13 · Encounter notes' badge
what: The badge reads '1 lines', a pluralization error. It should be '1 line'.

where: middle-bottom, expanded 'Oct 13 (prior)' card, last row 'Patient 09:03 AM'
what: The expanded card ends on a speaker label and timestamp with no utterance text under it. The 12-line transcript looks cut off at the card edge, with no scroll cue or 'show more'.
Card titles use two formats on the same screen: 'Oct 13 (prior)' and 'Oct 13 · Encounter notes'. Both are dated Oct 13, and the reader can't tell how they differ.

where: top, 'Dictate' button in the notes card and a second 'Dictate' button in the Tasks header
what: Two 'Dictate' buttons with the same label and icon are about 200px apart, in different styles (light and black). Nothing on either button says which one dictates notes and which one dictates tasks.
The 'DATA:' field is empty, a label with no value. It looks like missing output, not a deliberate 'none'.
The values are shown inside literal double quotes, with uppercase raw keys (CODE:, LEVEL:). It reads like unformatted model output, not a finished UI.
The RISK field holds a long treatment plan (continue antibiotics, reassess, discuss with pharmacy) instead of a risk level. A physician checking the billing level would find this confusing.

Long medication strings are cut off in single-line inputs: 'Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV every 8' loses 'hours extended infusion', and 'Furosemide 40 mg IV twice daily, increa…' is clipped mid-character. The full dose and frequency can't be checked while editing.

where: middle-bottom, change-note inputs next to the status selects
what: Change notes are clipped mid-word: 'dose increased for volume over', 'stopped for platelet drop, hepa', and 'awaiting cultures, renal dosing' with 'review' missing.
Only 'Cancel' is visible in the editor header. There is no Save or Done in view, so it's unclear how to commit the edits.

where: middle, Enoxaparin row: 'discontinued' badge and 'Stopped · Oct 13' chip
what: One row uses two different words for the same state, 'discontinued' and 'Stopped'. Other rows also show the status twice ('held' + 'Held · Oct 12', 'changed' + 'Changed · Oct 14'), which is redundant.
The badge text is struck through and gray on a light gray pill, which makes it hard to read.

The med name column starts at a different x position in each row, depending on the width of the status badge ('held', 'active', 'changed', 'discontinued', 'single dose'). The names form a ragged left edge.

This tracker puts the status pill on the right; the Pre-Round meds panel puts it on the left. 'changed' is red here and amber in the panel. Notes here are orange with a ⚡ icon, and gray without one in the panel. The same data is styled differently on two screens.
A trailing '·' followed by a bare em dash looks like an empty placeholder field.
Hospital shows 'not mentioned today' under Atorvastatin; the NH panel shows nothing there. The NH panel otherwise has the same redundant status pairs as Hospital ('discontinued' vs 'Stopped').
The status badge says 'discontinued' and the chip says 'Stopped · Oct 13', two different terms for one state.

where: top, stat tiles row, 'In Progress' tile
what: 'In Progress' wraps onto two lines, so its '0' sits lower than the numbers in the Total, Pending and Complete tiles.

where: top, stat tiles row, 'In Progress' tile
what: 'In Progress' wraps onto two lines, so its '0' sits lower than the numbers in the other three tiles.

where: middle, faint gray warning-triangle icons next to each task's trash icon
what: The triangle icons are very low contrast and have no label, so their meaning isn't explained. They sit close to the trash icon (about 75px apart), which makes a mis-tap likely. The NH tasks screen doesn't show them.

where: bottom, pale green button with spinner 'Finalizing Encounter Data...'
what: The main action is stuck in a faded loading state, and the screen gives no hint of progress or what to do next.
The task text is struck through as if done, but its checkbox is empty (teal outline). Hospital shows the same task as checked. The completion state is ambiguous.
The button is grayed out with no text explaining why it can't be pressed.

NH shows a 'Nursing Home' pill and an MRN and has no 'Meds' sub-tab. The active Post-Round tab is teal here and black on Hospital. Hospital says 'Mark Encounter Complete' and NH says 'Mark Visit Complete'. Some of this may be intentional, but the shared controls look different.
The copy icon is tiny, much smaller than the text, and looks like a broken or mis-scaled glyph.

The copy icon is tiny and mis-scaled next to the label, the same as on Hospital.
